_about: The standing people of the world (story-outline.md § 人物): each a name, what they are, the voice they speak in, where they live and their portrait. A scene line `who: <id>` speaks as them — the page draws the name and the portrait, Look hands Ling the voice. Ling writes their live lines in that voice and never another's. Portraits are original, painted with the local FLUX recipe (art/people/).
_hero: The hero is fixed (Hanli, 2026-09-30; story DESIGN § 四): 沈小满, a boy — no name card, no gender pick. The rules fill {name} from here in the scene's language; a save's own name/gender is replaced on load (state.mjs fitWorld).
_slots: A line's `who` may name a slot instead of a person: the rules fill it from the save. `ban` is the close companion — 阿禾 (周禾), the neighbour's girl of 石坳村, fixed since 2026-09-30 (she was the hero's other gender before).
_address: Words the rules fill into scene text: {兄姐} how the temple addresses him, {伴} the companion's name, {伴·孩}/{伴·她} what 阿禾 is, and the companion's unnamed cameos in the trials ({伴·阶} the steps, {伴·洛书} the 洛书, {伴·殿} the hall — the red nose, the little notebook, the braids; never named in a cameo). Fixed words since the hero is fixed (2026-09-30); they were keyed by the player's gender before.

伴·阶.zh:
你从一个扎两根小辫子的姑娘身边走过去——不对，是她从你身边冲过去。她没坐下，也没哭，鼻头冻得通红，像一根萝卜，咬着牙，一口气往上冲。

那个背影……有点眼熟。

你想多看两眼，她已经冲上去了，只剩一截小辫子，一晃，就没了。
伴·阶.en:
You pass a girl with two little braids — no: she passes you, charging. She doesn't sit, doesn't cry; her nose is frozen red as a radish, and she grits her teeth and takes the steps in one breath.

That back… looks familiar.

You want a second look, but she's already gone up — the end of a braid, a flick, and nothing.

伴·洛书.zh:
石壁那一头，另一面石壁前，早有人摆好了。一个红鼻头的姑娘，正拿一根炭条，在一个小本子上低头记着什么。

小本子。

你愣了一下。这年头，谁出门还带个本子记账？

你还没想明白，人群一挤，她就不见了。
伴·洛书.en:
At the far end, before another stone wall, someone has already finished. A red-nosed girl, head down, is writing something in a little notebook with a stick of charcoal.

A little notebook.

You stop short. Who goes out these days carrying a notebook to keep accounts in?

Before you can work it out, the crowd shifts, and she's gone.

伴·殿.zh:
排在你前面第三个的，是一个扎两根小辫子的姑娘。执事刚背完规矩——「本观三百年，没测出过一个……轮不到泗水」——她把手放上去。

测灵石只亮一色。青的，青得满殿的人睁不开眼。

**执事**：（张着嘴，半天才念）木……木天灵根。单灵根。上上之资。

殿里一下没了声。上头的观主站起来，走下座，一只手按在那姑娘头顶。

**观主**：这个，我收了。

他朝殿门外看了一眼，声音不高。

**观主**：沉鼎观的人。

唱名的执事往殿外瞟了一瞟。那姑娘仰起脸，头一句是：「拜师……要交钱么？」

人太多，你只看见一截小辫子，一晃，就被人群挡住了。

红鼻头。小辫子。小本子。

你心里咯噔一下——不会吧？

可石坳村的姑娘，怎么会跑到这儿来？她娘连村口都不让她出。

你摇摇头，一定是看错了。
伴·殿.en:
Third in line ahead of you is a girl with two little braids. The steward has just finished reciting the rules — "In three hundred years this temple has never found a single one… it never falls to the Si" — when she lays her hand on the stone.

The stone lights one colour only. Green — so green the whole hall has to squint.

**Steward:** (mouth open; it takes him a while to read it out) Wood… a heavenly Wood root. A single root. The highest grade.

The hall goes silent. Up on the dais the Abbot rises, comes down from his seat, and rests a hand on the girl's head.

**Abbot:** This one is mine.

He glances out past the hall doors, and does not raise his voice.

**Abbot:** She belongs to Chending Temple.

The steward who calls the names flicks a look outside. The girl tips her face up, and the first thing she says is: "Becoming your disciple… does it cost money?"

There are too many people — just the end of a braid, a flick, and the crowd closes over it.

A red nose. Little braids. A little notebook.

Something in you lurches — surely not?

But how would a girl from Shi'ao Village end up here? Her mother won't even let her past the village gate.

You shake your head. You must have seen wrong.

外门·柴房.zh:
你蹲了下去，抱住了头。

拳头和脚，像下雨一样落下来。

你没有还手。你护着胸口那块木牌，缩成一团。

你数着。一下。两下。十下。二十下。
外门·柴房.en:
You crouch down and cover your head.

Fists and feet come down like rain.

You don't fight back. You shield the token on your chest and curl up into a ball.

You count. One. Two. Ten. Twenty.

外门·伤.zh: 左边眼睛肿得睁不开。肋骨那儿，一吸气就疼。
外门·伤.en: Your left eye is swollen shut. Your ribs hurt every time you breathe in.

外门·伤处.en: the eye swollen up like a steamed bun

_jin: 今线's people (the interludes, 2026-10-05; story/jiuding-lu/今线/定例.md § 三): `line: "jin"`, no home on the map, a name card until a portrait is painted, and never in the 图鉴 (codex.js) — 同魂不同命 is never said.

role.zh: 泗水渡口撑船的老人
role.en: The old ferryman at the Si crossing

voice.zh: 话少，一句顶一句；爱说「水知道」。有话说到一半就咽回去。
voice.en: Few words, each one meant; fond of saying "the water knows". Stops halfway through what he will not say.

role.zh: 邻家{伴·孩}，比你小一岁；{伴·她}家也欠马家的租
role.en: The {伴·孩} next door, a year younger than you; {伴·她} family owes the Mas rent too

voice.zh: 冷着脸俏皮：一本正经地算账，「利息另算」——这份俏皮只给沈小满；对外人客气、精明。肚里书多，算得快，主意多；心软，可到了要紧时候出手不犹豫——「记账，以后还。」
voice.en: Deadpan mischief: she keeps the accounts with a perfectly straight face — "interest charged separately" — and saves that teasing for Shen Xiaoman alone; to everyone else she is polite and shrewd. Well read, quick with numbers, full of schemes; soft-hearted, yet when it counts she does not hesitate — "Keep count; pay me back."

role.zh: 沉鼎观守山门的执事，三试的考官
role.en: The temple's gatekeeper, examiner of the three trials

voice.zh: 冷、严、公道；话短，从不撒谎，夸人也像在训人。
voice.en: Cold, strict and fair; short words, never a lie. Even his praise sounds like a scolding.

role.zh: 沉鼎观观主
role.en: Abbot of Chending Temple

voice.zh: 温和，说话留半句；笑着，却让人猜不透。
voice.en: Mild, and leaves half of every sentence unsaid; he smiles, and gives nothing away.

role.zh: 外门执事，发功课、记灵石
role.en: Steward of the outer court, who sets the chores and keeps the accounts

voice.zh: 爱讲规矩、爱记账，句句带数；刻薄，但不坏。
voice.en: Loves rules and ledgers, every sentence has a number in it; sharp-tongued, but not unkind.

role.zh: 石坳村的老猎户，五十多了，膝盖有旧伤
role.en: The old hunter of Shi'ao village, past fifty, with a bad knee

voice.zh: 老实，话少，句句软，心更软；弯着腰陪笑，从不说人坏话；急了只说一句「闭嘴」。
voice.en: Honest and slow of speech, every word soft and his heart softer; he bows and smiles, never speaks ill of anyone; frightened for you, he says only "Quiet."

role.zh: 织布换米的猎户妻，落魄塾师的女儿，识字会算
role.en: A hunter's wife who weaves for rice; a poor schoolmaster's daughter who reads and reckons

voice.zh: 话少，心细，每句都算过；不问，只看；说一半，留一半让你自己想。
voice.en: Few words, each one reckoned; she does not ask, she watches; says half and leaves you the other half.

role.zh: 村东头的瞎眼老太太，全村最老
role.en: The blind old woman at the village's east end, the oldest in it

voice.zh: 慢，轻，像早知道了；问一句，不等人答；她讲的，总比别人多一句。
voice.en: Slow and soft, as if she already knew; asks and does not wait for the answer; she always says one thing more than anyone else.

role.zh: 马家收租的，比门框还宽
role.en: The Ma family's rent collector, wider than a door frame

voice.zh: 粗，横，笑声像破锣；拿短棍敲门框说话，句句是威胁。
voice.en: Coarse and overbearing, a laugh like a cracked gong; talks by rapping his club on the door frame, every sentence a threat.

role.zh: 马三的儿子，比你大两岁，穿绸子
role.en: Ma San's son, two years older than you, in silk

voice.zh: 阴阳怪气，爱看人出丑；「哟」字开头，笑得像他爹。
voice.en: Sneering and sly, loves to watch others shamed; starts with "Well, well", and laughs like his father.

role.zh: 娘的亲弟弟，县城济世堂的账房
role.en: Mother's younger brother, a bookkeeper in the county town

voice.zh: 体面，讲究，话里带着账房的数；叹气多，笑得难看；二十年前爬到一百六十级石阶，没上去——心里一直有这块石阶。
voice.en: Proper and particular, a bookkeeper's numbers in his talk; sighs a lot and smiles badly; twenty years ago he stopped at the hundred-and-sixtieth step, and still carries it.

role.zh: 邻居，种地的，{伴}的爹
role.en: The neighbour, a farmer; {伴}'s father

voice.zh: 粗声，实在，一句是一句；喊人像喊牲口，心是热的。
voice.en: Gruff and plain, every word meant; hollers like he's calling cattle, and has a warm heart.

role.zh: 外门讲课的先生，五十来岁，留一撮山羊胡子
role.en: The outer court's lecturer, about fifty, with a little goat beard

voice.zh: 先讲一段，再点一个人起来问；心情不好的时候比较多。刻薄，可肚子里是真学问——《内经》《本草》《抱朴子》张口就来。
voice.en: Lectures a stretch, then calls someone up to answer; is in a bad mood more often than not. Sharp-tongued, but truly learned — he quotes the Neijing, the Bencao and the Baopuzi without looking.

role.zh: 外门弟子，灵根比你当初还差；他娘给他缝了一个护身符
role.en: An outer disciple whose roots are worse than yours were; his mother sewed him a charm

voice.zh: 说话结巴，胆子小，心眼实；在梦里喊「娘，我不吃糠」。
voice.en: Stammers, timid, honest to the bone; cries "Ma, I won't eat chaff" in his sleep.

role.zh: 在外门排了三年队、等着进内门的真灵根师姐；她爹是猎户
role.en: A true-root senior who has queued three years in the outer court for a place in the inner court; her father is a hunter

voice.zh: 话少，眼尖，出手留三分；看得出别人藏着什么。
voice.en: Few words, sharp eyes, always holds a little back; sees what others are hiding.

role.zh: 针灸推拿学大一，十八岁，山东德州乡下人；校篮球队末一名替补，0号
role.en: First-year acupuncture and tuina student, eighteen, from the Dezhou countryside in Shandong; the last substitute on the college basketball team, number 0

voice.zh: 话多，一张嘴先替自己找补；心里管自己叫「沈芒啊沈芒」。
voice.en: Talks a lot, and every time he opens his mouth he is covering for himself first; in his head he calls himself "Shen Mang, oh Shen Mang".

role.zh: 周禾，运动康复大二，二十岁；校篮球队领队，本子、笔、计算器不离手
role.en: Zhou He, second-year sports rehabilitation, twenty; manager of the college basketball team, never without her notebook, pen and calculator

voice.zh: 不高不急，像在报一个数；什么都先记一笔，再说话；人家说笑话，她不笑，记。
voice.en: Never loud, never hurried, as if reading out a number; she writes it down first and speaks after; when someone makes a joke she doesn't laugh — she notes it.

role.zh: 中药学大三，一米九三，校队中锋；家里开马氏大药房
role.en: Third-year Chinese materia medica, one ninety-three, the team's centre; his family owns Ma's Pharmacy

voice.zh: 随随便便、和和气气，笑着说吓人的话；「没事」「小意思」。
voice.en: Easy-going and friendly, saying frightening things with a smile; "No problem." "Small stuff."

role.zh: 雷建军，体育部老师，校篮球队主教练、院系杯裁判长
role.en: Lei Jianjun, PE teacher, head coach of the college basketball team and chief referee of the inter-school cup

voice.zh: 吼；脸晒得像一块酱牛肉，哨子、秒表不离身。
voice.en: Bellows; a face tanned like braised beef, whistle and stopwatch always on him.

role.zh: 葛秀英，图书馆古籍部返聘的老馆员，七十二岁
role.en: Ge Xiuying, seventy-two, the retired restorer rehired at the library's rare-books room

voice.zh: 慢，一句扯出十句；讲古总讲错朝代，絮叨半天，顺嘴夹一句有用的。
voice.en: Slow; one sentence pulls out ten; always gets the dynasty wrong, rambles on, and slips in one useful thing on the way.

role.zh: 林远，同宿舍对床，天文社；全班唯一照书单借书的人
role.en: Lin Yuan, the bed opposite in the dorm, astronomy club; the only one in the class who borrows from the reading list

voice.zh: 一本正经；扶一下眼镜：「我查了。」——他查的都对。
voice.en: Dead serious; pushes up his glasses: "I looked it up." What he looks up is always right.

role.zh: 蔡文博，同宿舍上铺，复读过一年
role.en: Cai Wenbo, the top bunk in the dorm, a year older for resitting the exam

voice.zh: 慢吞吞，半睡不醒；什么都拿修仙小说讲，讲得离谱，又离真的不远。
voice.en: Slow, half asleep; explains everything by cultivation novels — absurdly, and yet not far from the truth.

role.zh: 严振华，教针灸推拿学导论和针灸实验课
role.en: Yan Zhenhua, who teaches Introduction to Acupuncture and Tuina and the acupuncture lab

voice.zh: 板正，照本宣科；下课前默写。
voice.en: Upright and by the book; a dictation before the bell.
